forbidden_paths.message: Remove supabase/supabase; use the canonical directories instead.

forbidden_tracked_path_regexes.message: Backup/patch artefacts must not be tracked; delete or move them under tmp/ and keep them untracked.
Backup-suffixed artefacts (*_bak.*) must not be tracked; delete them or rename to a real versioned asset.
Provisioning scripts must live under scripts/clients/ (not scripts/data/).
Third-party repo snapshots under scripts/data must be moved under scripts/data/vendor/ and renamed to remove branch suffixes (-master/-main).
Standalone tooling apps must live under tooling/apps/ (no package.json outside tooling/apps/).

scripts_root_message: scripts/ root must contain only README.md; move ad-hoc scripts into scripts/dev/ (debug) or scripts/tools/ (one-off utilities).
